{{Top}}
'''Porcine''' creatures were [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] that carried characteristics of [[Swine|pigs]], which sometimes included a large physical size, tusks, hooves, and a blunt-ended [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]],<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Roba/Legends|robas]],<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> and [[Halurian ice-boar]]s were all porcine [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|11|Halurian ice-boar}}</ref>
